summary.text: Brand marketing profile with strength in research-led decision support, campaign analytics, performance reporting, audience insights, social listening, paid social marketing, organic social marketing. Built data + AI pipelines (FastAPI, Python, SQL, Google BigQuery, Bruin) to turn noisy inputs into traceable, reviewable outputs and trusted datasets for reporting and analysis.

bullets: Conducted brand audit and product audit by integrating sales analysis, retail audit fieldwork, brand health tracking, consumer panel analysis, market intelligence, and industry reports to evaluate portfolio analysis performance and find growth opportunities.

Supported integrated campaign work with campaign analytics, media planning, audience segmentation, media optimization, social listening, audience insights, brand lift analysis, and performance reporting.

projects.name: FitCV
bullets: Built AI-assisted job-matching + CV-generation pipeline turning noisy job inputs into structured, reviewable CV outputs via staged filtering, ranking, analysis, generation, validation, artifact-backed inspection.

Designed staged workflow to filter, evaluate, refine job opportunities before CV generation; cut manual tailoring effort, limit unnecessary AI processing via deterministic gates, improve trust via traceable run evidence + diagnostics.
Used hybrid matching approach combining screening rules, exact signals, evidence-based review to improve shortlist quality before time-intensive generation steps.
Stack: fastapi, python, system design, llm workflow design
